title: Invertibility of the explicitly adjoint restricted tensor unit on a fixed chart
statement: For arbitrary scheme maps f:X -> S and g:S prime -> S, a module F, resolutions I and J, opens V and W with W <= g inverse V, flat-base-change open choices D, and an algebra structure Gamma(S,V) -> Gamma(S prime,W), define h,N,T,G,U,L,e,M,j,c,r,q exactly as in the recorded Lean statement. Fix any scheme isomorphism sigma:L -> T with ef:sigma.hom followed by baseChangeFst h equals j followed by q. Let b be the restriction/pullback comparison inverse followed by D.psi, pushforward(q) of r, the pushforward(j,q) composition comparison, then the inverse congruence comparison for ef and inverse composition comparison for sigma.hom and baseChangeFst h. The inverse adjunction hom-equivalence for baseChangeFst h applied to this explicit b is an isomorphism of modules. No affineness or compatibility of the algebra map is assumed: these are needed only to construct the geometric chart, which is given here.

source.place: Lemma 6.26.2 adjunction; Lemma 6.26.3 (0097) composition; 02KH first paragraph affine-local coefficient dictionary, with D.unit_square.

proof.text: Set p=pullback.snd g f, a=(f inverse V).iota, t=baseChangeFst h and l=L.iota. The chart equality ef and restriction equations give (sigma.hom followed by t) followed by a equals l followed by p. Identify the right adjoints of the composite restriction-a/pullback-t/pullback-sigma adjunction and of tensor-pullback-p/restriction-l using the pushforward composition and congruence isomorphisms. Uniqueness of left adjoints gives an actual coefficient isomorphism; prepend the pullback of the inverse restriction/pullback comparison along a to obtain k:sigma^* A isomorphic to M.

Construct an inverse functor to pushforward sigma.hom using pushforward sigma.inv and the pushforward composition, congruence and identity isomorphisms. Thus the sigma pullback-pushforward adjunction unit is invertible. The transpose of k.hom is its unit followed by pushforward of an isomorphism, hence is invertible. Apply the general restriction-chart unit normalization to p,a,U.iota,l,j,q,t,sigma, the restriction equations and D.unit_square. It identifies this invertible transpose with the explicit inverse transpose of b. Rewrite to obtain the required IsIso instance.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0096 and 0097; the two-step chart coefficient argument using uniqueness of composite left adjoints; the general unit-normalization equation is proved from the unit square by restriction maps on opens.

theorem isIso_flatBaseChange_chart_unit_adjoint
    {X S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (F : X.Modules) (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))
    (V : S.Opens) (W : S'.Opens)
    (eVW : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) (D : FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V)
    [Algebra Γ(S, V) Γ(S', W)] :
    let h := f.resLE V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl ≫ V.toSpecΓ
    let N := (pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F
    let T := baseChangedScheme (S := Γ(S', W)) h
    let A := baseChangedModule (S := Γ(S', W)) h N
    let G := (tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F
    let U := (pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    let L := (pullback.fst g f) ⁻¹ᵁ W
    let e : L ≤ U := by
      change (pullback.fst g f) ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤ (pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      rw [flatBaseChangeOpenEquality f g V]
      exact (pullback.fst g f).preimage_mono eVW
    let M := (restrictFunctor L.ι).obj G
    let j := (Limits.pullback g f).homOfLE e
    let c := (restrictFunctorComp j U.ι).symm.app G ≪≫
      (restrictFunctorCongr ((Limits.pullback g f).homOfLE_ι e)).app G
    let r := (restrictAdjunction j).unit.app ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj G) ≫
      (pushforward j).map c.hom
    let q := (pullback.snd g f).resLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) U le_rfl
    ∀ (σ : L.toScheme ≅ T)
      (ef : σ.hom ≫ baseChangeFst (S := Γ(S', W)) h = j ≫ q),
      let b := ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).app F).inv ≫
        D.psi ≫ (pushforward q).map r ≫
        (pushforwardComp j q).hom.app M ≫ (pushforwardCongr ef).inv.app M ≫
        (pushforwardComp σ.hom (baseChangeFst (S := Γ(S', W)) h)).inv.app M
      IsIso ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (baseChangeFst (S := Γ(S', W)) h)).homEquiv _ _ |>.symm b)
